journey.en: Life is a journey full of surprises and lessons.
journey.cn: 人生是一段充满惊喜与教训的旅程。

memory.en: I have wonderful memories of last summer's beach trip.
memory.cn: 去年夏天的海滩之旅给我留下了美好的回忆。

diary.en: I have kept a daily diary for three years now.
diary.cn: 我已经坚持写日记三年了。

wonderful.en: We had a wonderful time at the science museum.
wonderful.cn: 我们在科技馆度过了美妙的时光。

share.en: I'll share my travel stories with the whole class.
share.cn: 我会把旅行故事分享给全班。

thank.en: Thank you for travelling with me this whole journey.
